name: prop_flow
description: The static prop/weapon pipeline: concept image -> Pixal3D mesh -> quad remesh (10K, prop preset) -> 8 turntable views. Ultra-low polygon budget for props, furniture, weapons, environment pieces. No rig stage. Composes the image and 3d cards internally. Start with {yaml: prop-flow} through the queue door.

prompt.description: Concept prompt when no image is supplied - flat background, full silhouette.

face_budget.description: Quad target for the remesh stage. Default 10000 (ultra-low).
